_comment: GENERATED by tools/parse-enemies.py - do not hand-edit. Enemy per-type tables, spawn scripts and graphics-load streams.

regions.name: Labyrinth spawn lists: 3 pointers
regions.description: $89FB reads $803C,Y / $803D,Y with Y = 2 * $0478[low nibble of $04C0,X], then (pointer),Y with the high nibble for an object type. Three pointers, $AF61, $AF69, $AF71; the 6 bytes are exactly the gap between the entry table and the code at $8042. How far each list runs is NOT established - the index can reach 15 and the lists are 8 apart.

regions.name: Layout step directions: -15, 1, 16, 17
regions.description: $82B9 LDA $82D9,Y with Y = the top two bits of a layout item: the step $82A3 adds between the six cells of its mask in the 16-wide room buffer - up-right, right, down, down-right. The BNE / BEQ pair at $82D5 jumps over it.

regions.name: Enemy graphics: the default load stream
regions.description: Sixteen [flags | slot][block][tile] records - $A46E points $28/$29 here with $27 = $80 on entering a room, and $E99F loads one block per pass into CHR at tile * 16, recording it in $0480/$0490. Bit 7 of the last record's first byte ($8F) ends it. THE CHECK: each record's tile is the previous one's plus that block's decoded tile count, all 15 pairs, $80 to $E2 + 14.

regions.name: Spawn script pointers: 47
regions.description: $A480: LDA $A4C5,Y / $A4C6,Y with Y = 2 * $57, the script id from the map record; $57 = 0 skips it, so entry 0 is never read and the table starts at $A4C7. 47 entries, ending where the first target, $A525, begins - and the map uses ids 1-47, every one.

regions.name: Enemy spawn scripts
regions.description: The scripts bank 7 $F78F runs: < 3 a command (0 wait, 1 jump, 2 end, via the inline table at $F7C9), else a spawn - bit 7 clear one object of that type, bit 7 set a formation [type|$80][count][interval] carried by a type-$29 spawner. A spawn is followed by another bit-7 spawn or a wait in units of 60 frames. THE CHECK: walked from the 47 pointers they cover this stretch byte for byte. NOT ESTABLISHED: five scripts ($A58D, $A5BF, $A5D6, $A5F4, $A61F) end [byte] 01 02, which the code reads as a long wait and then a jump whose operand overlaps the next script. tools/parse-enemies.py --scripts decodes them all.

regions.name: Special rooms: sub-id to record
regions.description: $A66B: LDY $5E / LDA $A682,Y, for rooms of kind $40 - and $A682 itself is code, the STA $27 two instructions on, so sub-ids 0-10 could not be used. The sub-ids those rooms carry run 11-32, so the bytes read are $A68D-$A6A2 - starting exactly after the code, ending exactly before the records. Values are offsets 0-36 in steps of 3.

regions.name: Special rooms: 13 x [type][stream]
regions.description: $A671-$A67D: the first byte to $72, the next two to $28/$29 as a graphics-load stream, then $27 = $80 starts the load. Types: $1D, $1E, $1F, $55, $56, $57, $58, $47, $5A, $5B, $5C, $5D, $5E. What $72 does is NOT established; bank 3 compares it with $4D.

regions.name: Special rooms: graphics-load streams
regions.description: Seven streams in the same [flags | slot][block][tile] format, named by the records at $A6A3. They tile this stretch exactly and end on the code at $A6EB; the tile positions inside them pack block by block like the default stream's.

regions.name: Hitbox half-width, by metasprite id
regions.description: $D229: $0530 +/- $C174,Y into $06F8/$06E0, Y = the metasprite id. 141 bytes, one per metasprite id - bounded by $C201, read by the same routine.

regions.name: Hitbox half-height, by metasprite id
regions.description: $D229: LDA $0548,X (the metasprite id) / TAY, then $0518 +/- $C201,Y into $0728/$0710 - the vertical extent $D364 overlaps. 140 bytes, ending where the metasprite pointer table begins; id 140 would read its first byte.

regions.name: The tile block holding each type's art
regions.description: $CF4C: type AND $7F, CMP #$0E / BCC returns 0, else LDA $CFB6,Y - so this table starts at type $0E, and it runs to $D02B, type $75. A negative entry means 'per object' ($07B8,X). $CF5F finds the id in the loaded list $0480 and makes the object wait until it is there; $0490 then gives the tile the block was loaded at. THE CHECK: all 52 distinct ids name a real tile block when routed the way $EA58 routes them (below $40 bank 3, else bank 2 id - $30).

regions.name: Enemy collision flags, by type
regions.description: $CFA0 copies it into the slot with LDA table,Y where Y = type AND $7F - four reads six bytes apart, which is also what bounds the tables. Destination $0578. $D348 skips an object whose bit 7 is set and ANDs the rest with the collision class it is testing ($30 or $20). 127 bytes, types 0-126: type $7F would read $D0AB's first byte.

regions.name: Enemy hit points, by type
regions.description: $CFA0 copies it into the slot with LDA table,Y where Y = type AND $7F - four reads six bytes apart, which is also what bounds the tables. Destination $0590, HIT POINTS: $D30E subtracts the other side's $05A8 from it, clamping at 0, and $D32A turns the object into its death type when it reaches 0. Families climb in step - types $10-$13 have 24, 32, 48, 80.

regions.name: Enemy attack, by type
regions.description: $CFA0 copies it into the slot with LDA table,Y where Y = type AND $7F - four reads six bytes apart, which is also what bounds the tables. Destination $05A8, ATTACK: the hit points an object takes from whatever it collides with ($D30E). For the player the damage is divided by the player's own $0590 first ($D2DC-$D2DF, through $F9AE).

regions.name: Per-type value copied to $0620
regions.description: $CFA0 copies it into the slot with LDA table,Y where Y = type AND $7F - four reads six bytes apart, which is also what bounds the tables. Destination $0620: DRAWING FLAGS. The draw path $CBE8 tests them bit by bit - bit 0 calls $CC88 and bit 1 $CCEB before drawing, bit 2 flips the attribute when $05D8 is non-negative, bit 3 is tested at $CC1F - so the per-type value says how the object is drawn. What each extra step does is not yet read. 128 bytes, ending at the code at $D229.

regions.name: What each type becomes at 0 HP
regions.description: $D32A: when $0590 reaches 0, LDA $D441,Y / STA $0500,X with Y = the type, after saving the old type in $0740. Mostly $08 and $07 - explosions. $D2F3 reads $D442 directly for the player (type 1). 128 bytes, ending at the code at $D4C1.
